purpose: Recover existing OKX/Onchain OS/Agentic Wallet readiness on BLACK without creating a wallet, logging in, moving funds, spending, or exposing secrets. Report only executable presence/state and whether required seller bindings exist.
command:
set -uo pipefail
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
echo "UTC=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
echo "===TOOLS==="
for c in node npm npx codex onchainos; do
  if command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf '%s=PRESENT path=' "$c"; command -v "$c"
  else
    echo "$c=ABSENT"
  fi
done
(node -v 2>/dev/null || true)
(npm -v 2>/dev/null || true)
(codex --version 2>/dev/null || true)
echo "===SELLER_BINDINGS_PRESENCE_ONLY==="
for k in OKX_API_KEY OKX_SECRET_KEY OKX_PASSPHRASE PAY_TO_ADDRESS; do
  if [ -n "${!k:-}" ]; then echo "$k=PRESENT"; else echo "$k=ABSENT"; fi
done
echo "===OKX_ONCHAIN_FILES==="
for d in "$HOME/.codex" "$HOME/.config" "$HOME/.local" "$HOME"; do
  [ -d "$d" ] || continue
  find "$d" -maxdepth 5 \( -iname '*onchainos*' -o -iname '*okx*' -o -iname '*agentic*' \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -120
done
echo "===NPM_GLOBAL_MATCHES==="
(npm root -g 2>/dev/null | xargs -r -I{} find "{}" -maxdepth 3 \( -iname '*onchainos*' -o -iname '*okx*' \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -80) || true
echo "OKX_PREFLIGHT_DONE"
